Navy background is the token #1A3580 (the source GLOW blue is CMYK 100/84.4/5.5/0.4, viewer #174797). White P is py-atom-symbol-p-plain scaled from 91.7 to 173.44 mm; Parkeren is Ubuntu Bold 35.28 mm. GLOW is the third party mark (reference only, source the official file). Pills: route = three active pills (Philips stadion arrow left, DLL arrow up, TD-gebouw arrow up); bestemming = Evoluon active with pin, Philips stadion and TD-gebouw inactive (25 percent, arrow left in print). Print arrows differ from the library arrows, see py-comp-pill-destination. Source details: the DLL label has a trailing space in the file (DLL and a space), label centres are set by eye per pill, pill pitch measured 51.61 and 51.41 mm (template uses 51.5). Variables: destination-N, arrow-N (left, up, pin), state-N (active, inactive).
